headword: {大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}
gloss: long holiday period; extended consecutive holidays

definitions.gloss: long holiday period; extended consecutive holidays
definitions.explanation: A series of consecutive holidays spanning several days. Most commonly refers to Golden Week in late April to early May, but also applies to other extended holiday periods like the New Year break or Obon.

examples.japanese: {大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}に{旅行|りょこう}する。
{大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}は{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}が{混|こ}む。
examples.english: Highways get congested during long holidays.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}は{最大|さいだい}で9{連休|れんきゅう}になるので、{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}を{計画|けいかく}している{人|ひと}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This year's long holiday could be up to nine consecutive days off, so many people are planning overseas trips.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう} most commonly refers to Golden Week ({ゴールデンウィーク|ごーるでんうぃーく}), the cluster of national holidays from late April to early May. NHK and other broadcasters use {大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう} instead of the trademarked term "Golden Week."

It can also refer to:
- {年末年始|ねんまつねんし} (New Year holiday period)
- {お盆休|おぼんやす}み (Obon vacation in mid-August)
- {シルバーウィーク|しるばーうぃーく} (Silver Week in September, in years when it forms)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}を{利用|りよう}する (take advantage of the long holiday)
- {大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}{中|ちゅう} (during the long holiday)
- {大型連休|おおがたれんきゅう}{明|あ}け (after the long holiday ends)
